content.json:
# CondoManager Ops

**Cost / latency / errors / HITL queue depth — CM-25.**

Most panels will be empty until CM-28 (LangGraph spine) and CM-30 (Triage Agent) ship live LLM traffic. The schema below is the deployment contract — future stories drop spans into these panels automatically.

Canonical KQL queries live in `docs/OBSERVABILITY.md`.

content.query:
// Coalesces openinference and OTel gen_ai semantic conventions for token + model.
// Pricing table — update when adopting a new model.
let model_rates = datatable(model: string, prompt_per_token: real, completion_per_token: real) [
    'gpt-4o-mini',  0.00000015, 0.00000060,
    'gpt-4o',       0.00000250, 0.00001000,
    'gpt-4-turbo',  0.00001000, 0.00003000
];
dependencies
| where customDimensions['gen_ai.system'] == 'openai'
    or customDimensions['openinference.span.kind'] == 'LLM'
| extend
    model = coalesce(
        tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model']),
        tostring(customDimensions['llm.model_name'])
    ),
    prompt_tokens = toint(coalesce(
        customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens'],
        customDimensions['llm.token_count.prompt']
    )),
    completion_tokens = toint(coalesce(
        customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens'],
        customDimensions['llm.token_count.completion']
    ))
| join kind=leftouter (model_rates) on model
| extend cost_usd =
    (prompt_tokens * coalesce(prompt_per_token, 0.0))
    + (completion_tokens * coalesce(completion_per_token, 0.0))
| summarize daily_cost_usd = sum(cost_usd) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Cost per day (USD) — token-count × model-rate

content.query:
// Latency percentiles across FastAPI handlers (CM-21 OTel auto-instrumentation).
requests
| where success in (true, false)
| summarize
    p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50),
    p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95),
    p99_ms = percentile(duration, 99)
  by bin(timestamp, 5m), operation_Name
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms) — per operation

content.query:
// LangGraph nodes emit spans with a `langgraph.node` custom attribute (CM-21 contract).
// Empty until CM-28+ ships agent traffic.
dependencies
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['langgraph.node']))
| extend agent = tostring(customDimensions['langgraph.node'])
| summarize
    total = count(),
    errors = countif(success == false)
  by bin(timestamp, 1h), agent
| extend error_rate_pct = todouble(errors) / total * 100.0
| project timestamp, agent, error_rate_pct
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Error rate (%) per LangGraph node

content.query:
// Contract for the future HITL story: emit `hitl.queued` when a task is
// pushed to a human reviewer, `hitl.resolved` when the reviewer signs off.
// Depth = cumulative queued − cumulative resolved per 5m bucket.
customEvents
| where name in ('hitl.queued', 'hitl.resolved')
| summarize
    queued = countif(name == 'hitl.queued'),
    resolved = countif(name == 'hitl.resolved')
  by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp asc
| extend running_queued = row_cumsum(queued)
| extend running_resolved = row_cumsum(resolved)
| extend queue_depth = running_queued - running_resolved
| project timestamp, queue_depth
content.title: HITL queue depth — cumulative queued − resolved

content.json:
## PRD success metrics (CM-45)

Per-agent PRD signals emitted via `emit_metric` (CM-39 / CM-44) into `customEvents`. Triage, knowledge, and HITL panels carry live data today; the **vendor** and **escalation** panels stay empty until CM-46 wires their emitters — the panel is the contract.

content.query:
// PRD: triage routing distribution. CM-39 emits metric.triage.route with a `route`
// customDimension (intent → route), the same quantity the offline eval gates.
customEvents
| where name == 'metric.triage.route'
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions['route'])
| summarize routed = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), route
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Triage routing volume by route

content.query:
// PRD: self-service resolution = answered / (answered + refused). CM-39 emits
// metric.knowledge.answered on a grounded answer and metric.knowledge.refused on handoff.
customEvents
| where name in ('metric.knowledge.answered', 'metric.knowledge.refused')
| summarize
    answered = countif(name == 'metric.knowledge.answered'),
    total = count()
  by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| extend self_service_pct = todouble(answered) / total * 100.0
| project timestamp, self_service_pct
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Knowledge self-service rate (%)

content.query:
// PRD: vendor auto-dispatch rate = auto_dispatch / (auto_dispatch + hitl).
// EMPTY until CM-46 emits metric.vendor.auto_dispatch / metric.vendor.hitl.
customEvents
| where name in ('metric.vendor.auto_dispatch', 'metric.vendor.hitl')
| summarize
    auto = countif(name == 'metric.vendor.auto_dispatch'),
    total = count()
  by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| extend auto_dispatch_pct = todouble(auto) / total * 100.0
| project timestamp, auto_dispatch_pct
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Vendor auto-dispatch rate (%)
Escalation legal-flag volume

content.query:
// PRD: HITL approval rate + average manager rating. CM-44 emits metric.hitl.rating
// with a `decision` dim (approve|reject), `has_rating`, and metric.value = the 1-5
// rating (or 1.0 when unrated).
customEvents
| where name == 'metric.hitl.rating'
| extend decision = tostring(customDimensions['decision'])
| summarize
    approved = countif(decision == 'approve'),
    total = count(),
    avg_rating = avgif(todouble(customDimensions['metric.value']), tobool(tostring(customDimensions['has_rating'])))
  by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| extend approval_pct = todouble(approved) / total * 100.0
| project timestamp, approval_pct, avg_rating
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: HITL approval rate (%) + avg manager rating
